originals.citation: Naj, A. C., Beecham, G. W., et al. (2010). Dementia revealed: novel chromosome 6 locus for late-onset Alzheimer disease provides genetic evidence for folate-pathway abnormalities. PLoS Genetics.

quote: We conducted a replication study of the 2 genetic variants, rs11754661 and rs2073067, in MTHFD1L that have been recently reported to be associated with late-onset Alzheimer's disease (LOAD) in a genome-wide study in Caucasians.
notes: The GWAS in Caucasians reporting MTHFD1L is Naj et al. 2010. @ren2011 and @ramrezlorca2011 are earlier replication attempts cited on the list, not the GWAS itself.
